document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: From the new residential districts of Astana to the suburbs of Shanghai, tower blocks have become the standard form of urban housing. In my view, although high-rise living has certain social and practical drawbacks, its advantages are greater, provided that the buildings are well designed and surrounded by adequate public space.

The main advantage is the efficient use of land. By building upwards, cities can house thousands of families on a small area, which limits the spread of suburbs into farmland and keeps journeys to work shorter. Dense neighbourhoods also make public transport, shops and schools more economical to run, since each bus route or clinic serves more people. Furthermore, modern towers often offer facilities that private houses cannot, such as lifts, security, underground parking and shared playgrounds.

On the other hand, tall buildings can weaken community ties. Residents of a twenty-storey block may share a lift every day without learning each other’s names, and families with young children often have little safe outdoor space nearby. There are practical concerns as well: when lifts break down, elderly residents can be trapped at home, and poorly built blocks may be difficult to evacuate in an emergency. Critics also point out that rows of identical towers can make whole districts look monotonous and impersonal.

In conclusion, high-rise housing is the most realistic way to accommodate growing urban populations, and its efficiency outweighs its drawbacks. However, these benefits depend on good planning: towers should be built to high safety standards and combined with parks, playgrounds and community centres where neighbours can meet, so that residents feel part of a community rather than simply occupants of a flat.

note.en: Gives the answer in the introduction.
note.ru: Вводит ответ на вопрос во введении.

note.en: A concession: drawbacks exist, but the benefits weigh more.
note.kk: Мойындау: кемшіліктер бар, бірақ артықшылықтар салмақтырақ.
note.ru: Уступка: минусы признаны, но плюсы весомее.

note.en: The condition under which the benefits win.
The topic sentence of the advantages paragraph.
Adds a second benefit — for the city as a whole.
note.kk: Екінші артықшылықты — бүкіл қалаға пайдасын қосады.
note.ru: Добавляет второй плюс — для города в целом.

note.en: Adds practical drawbacks to the social ones.

strengths.en: The writer answers “outweigh” directly but says under what condition the answer holds.
strengths.kk: Автор «outweigh» сұрағына тура жауап береді, бірақ жауабы қандай шартта дұрыс екенін нақтылайды.
strengths.ru: Автор отвечает на «outweigh» прямо, но уточняет, при каком условии его ответ верен.
strengths.example: provided that the buildings are well designed and surrounded by adequate public space

strengths.en: Each benefit is explained: not just cheaper, but why it is cheaper.
strengths.kk: Әр артықшылық түсіндірілген: жай «арзанырақ» емес, неге арзан екені айтылған.
strengths.ru: Каждый плюс объяснён: не просто «дешевле», а почему дешевле.
strengths.example: since each bus route or clinic serves more people

strengths.en: The lift image shows isolation better than general words.
strengths.kk: Лифт туралы көрініс оқшаулықты жалпы сөздерден жақсы көрсетеді.
strengths.ru: Картинка с лифтом показывает разобщённость лучше общих слов.
strengths.example: may share a lift every day without learning each other’s names

strengths.en: The conclusion says exactly what to do so the drawbacks disappear.
strengths.kk: Қорытынды кемшіліктерді жою үшін нақты не істеу керегін айтады.
strengths.ru: Вывод говорит, что именно сделать, чтобы минусы исчезли.
strengths.example: combined with parks, playgrounds and community centres where neighbours can meet

note.en: Introduction: a familiar picture (Astana, Shanghai) and a direct answer to “outweigh” with a provided-that condition.
note.kk: Кіріспе: таныс көрініс (Астана, Шанхай) және provided that шарты бар «outweigh» сұрағына тура жауап.
note.ru: Введение: узнаваемая картина (Астана, Шанхай) и прямой ответ на «outweigh» с условием provided that.

note.en: Advantages: land saved, cheaper infrastructure, facilities — each point explained.
note.kk: Артықшылықтар: жерді үнемдеу, инфрақұрылымның арзандығы, ыңғайлылық — әр дәлелдің «неге» деген түсіндірмесі бар.
note.ru: Плюсы: экономия земли, дешевле инфраструктура, удобства — каждый довод с объяснением «почему».

note.en: Disadvantages: weak ties between neighbours, practical risks (lifts, evacuation) and monotonous districts.
note.kk: Кемшіліктер: көршілер арасындағы әлсіз байланыс, практикалық тәуекелдер (лифт, эвакуация) және аудандардың бір сарынды келбеті.
note.ru: Минусы: слабые связи между соседями, практические риски (лифты, эвакуация) и однообразный облик районов.

note.en: Conclusion: the answer and a concrete condition — good planning can remove the drawbacks.
note.kk: Қорытынды: сұраққа жауап және нақты шарт — кемшіліктерді дұрыс жоспарлау арқылы азайтуға болады.
note.ru: Вывод: ответ на вопрос и конкретное условие — минусы можно снять планировкой.

document.title: Living in high-rise buildings
document.question:
In many cities, more and more people live in high-rise apartment buildings. Some think this is the only practical way to house a growing urban population, while others believe it harms people’s quality of life.

Do the advantages of living in high-rise buildings outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
